serviceTab.title: Servizio
serviceTab.caption: Daemon di trascrizione locale per app e strumenti.

daemon.discoveryMissing: Nessun documento di discovery — il servizio non è in esecuzione.
daemon.discoveryStale: Esiste un documento di discovery, ma il daemon non è raggiungibile.
daemon.stopConfirmBody: I client connessi verranno disconnessi. Il daemon termina il lavoro in corso e si arresta in modo ordinato.
daemon.alreadyRunningToast: Il servizio è già in esecuzione
daemon.stoppedHint: Start the service to accept clients.

token.memoryNote: Stored locally in gui-client.json (owner-only). Never logged.
token.rotateConfirmBody: Tutti i client connessi vengono disconnessi immediatamente. Il token corrente smetterà di funzionare. Il nuovo token viene mostrato una sola volta — conservalo in un posto sicuro.
token.newTokenBody: Copialo ora — non verrà mostrato di nuovo.
token.rotatedToast: Token ruotato — i client connessi sono stati chiusi
token.connectionUrlCaption: ⚠ Token in URL — prefer the Authorization header for scripts.
token.noTokenYet: Start the service to load the token

sessions.caption: Live WebSocket sessions holding the inference lease. Batch transcriptions do not appear here.

errors.noToken: Nessun token in memoria — incollane uno qui sopra per interrogare le rotte autenticate.
errors.unauthorized: Token rifiutato. Potrebbe essere stato ruotato altrove.

examples.repoLinkCaption: Ready-to-run SDK and raw-HTTP (curl, Node, Python) scripts live in the repo's examples/ directory.

connection.baseUrlCaption: Reachable from this machine. Every /v1 route needs the bearer token.
connection.withTokenCaption: Handy for scripts and mobile clients. Tokens in URLs can appear in logs — prefer the Authorization header.

modelSection.chooseModelCaption: Download a local model to start transcribing.
modelSection.notDownloadedWarning: Not downloaded — transcription won't work until you download it.
modelSection.modelLibraryCaption: Select an installed model to use it, or download another model for local transcription.
modelSection.localModelsNote: Models run locally on your machine. Downloads are stored on this device.
modelSection.removeModelBody: This frees {{size}} on this machine. You can download it again anytime.

transforms.futureTranscriptsOnly: Applies to future transcripts only — history is not re-processed.
transforms.noPatterns: No patterns yet. Add one below.

history.deleteAllBody: Are you sure you want to delete all transcripts? This action cannot be undone.
history.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. The audio file is removed too.

about.footer: voxix — a Linux speech-to-text app, built on the voxix speech-to-text engine. MIT licensed.
